svg.title: AI Helpdesk system architecture
svg.desc: System architecture: one repository holds two agent services and the contract between them. The staff console (React 18, Vite) posts a question to the support agent in backend/, a FastAPI service on Python 3.12 with asyncio, and customers reach it through Nginx; the answer streams back over SSE. The support agent runs five stages: 1 Understand, an intent vote with working memory; 2 Gather, a hybrid search and a delegation over A2A; 3 Route, to specialist agents; 4 Answer, in a bounded tool loop; 5 Verify, which renders the reply from verified evidence, or hands off to staff review as a Case or ticket. Gather delegates data questions over A2A, JSON-RPC, to the SQL agent in ai-sql-agent/, a FastAPI service on Python 3.11 that retrieves tables with BM25 and vectors, plans a step per source, has a model write SQL, checks it at an SQLGlot AST gate and runs it read-only with repair; evidence returns over SSE. Contract v1.15, JSON Schemas and golden fixtures, is tested on both sides. Below them: PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector and tsvector, Redis 7 for memory and the run queue, Kafka as an optional turn event log, the Anthropic and OpenAI model APIs, and the business data the SQL agent reads. Platform: Docker Compose, Kubernetes, KEDA, Nginx, OpenTelemetry, Grafana and GitHub Actions. A pulse follows one data question through all of it in that order.
